scripts.data: cargo run --release --manifest-path pipeline/Cargo.toml -- all && pnpm data:scene && pnpm data:places && pnpm data:city
scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path pipeline/Cargo.toml && node scripts/test-pipeline.mjs && pnpm --filter web test && pnpm --filter worker test
scripts.data:vignette: .venv/bin/python pipeline/scripts/extract_overture.py roads landuse infra buildings && .venv/bin/python pipeline/scripts/vignette.py && .venv/bin/python pipeline/scripts/vignette_traffic.py && .venv/bin/python pipeline/scripts/vignette_trees.py
scripts.data:city: .venv/bin/python pipeline/scripts/extract_overture.py roads rail landuse infra buildings && .venv/bin/python pipeline/scripts/vignette.py downtown && .venv/bin/python pipeline/scripts/vignette_traffic.py downtown && .venv/bin/python pipeline/scripts/vignette_trees.py downtown && .venv/bin/python pipeline/scripts/arterials.py && pnpm data:terrain && pnpm data:midtown
